text:
jules: heads up — main is red after the last merge, looks like smoke tests failing in the translation job. anyone oncall?
ci-bot: Workflow 'smoke-e2e' failed on main (run/10983). Failed job: translation-smoke (exit code 1). Logs: https://ci.example.com/runs/10983
samir: @jules can you paste the failing test log snippet?
jules: sure, copying relevant part:
```
E   AssertionError: expected 'Hello — ¿Qué tal?' to match snapshot
.../tests/translate/test_snapshot.py:42
```
It started right after the docs translation PR (#8743) merged.
nora: that PR was docs + localized markdown, maybe encoding? cc @samir
samir: okay, I'll kick a rerun first. oncall, if it keeps failing we may need a quick bisect. ci-bot, retry smoke-e2e for run/10983
ci-bot: Retry requested by samir. New run: 10986. Will report back.
oncall-sre: grabbing this. If rerun fails, I'll run binary search between commit abc123..def456
ci-bot: Run 10986 completed — translation-smoke passed, all green :white_check_mark:
jules: interesting — flakey. Could be snapshot refresh needed. @nora did the PR touch any fixtures?
nora: only changed markdown in /docs/pt-br and updated a few translations csvs. no test fixtures intentionally. I'll diff the files and run tests locally.
samir: thanks. leaving note: if it flakes again, we'll bisect and pin failing commit. For now marking as transient and closing the alert.
jules: adding a follow-up ticket to run full snapshot regen in CI for i18n changes. thanks all :thumbsup:
